full_judgment: 7. Leave was granted that the finding of facts has been reversed by the High Court Division without cogent reasons and on unsubstantial grounds and this reversal is not in accordance with the well settled principles regarding appreciation of evidence and the benefit of doubt that was given by the High Court was not warranted inasmuch as no plea was put by the defence specifically which would raise a doubt in herring the evidence for giving benefit to the accused.
